journalEnabled.name: Journal case
journalEnabled.hint: The Journal button opens the journal as cards (what Scroll Case was). Off: the stock Journal tab, and nothing of the case is drawn.

journalClassic.name: Journal: Classic Mode
journalClassic.hint: On this client, the Journal button opens Foundry's own Journal tab. The tab carries a Card Catalogue button to come back.

scenesEnabled.name: Scenes case
scenesEnabled.hint: The Scenes button opens the scenes as wide cards, one-click Activate with an Undo. GM only. Off: the stock Scenes tab.

scenesClassic.name: Scenes: Classic Mode
scenesClassic.hint: On this client, the Scenes button opens Foundry's own Scenes tab.

actorsEnabled.name: Actors case
actorsEnabled.hint: The Actors button opens the actors as portrait cards; Open is one click. Off: the stock Actors tab.

actorsClassic.name: Actors: Classic Mode
actorsClassic.hint: On this client, the Actors button opens Foundry's own Actors tab.

itemsEnabled.name: Items case
itemsEnabled.hint: The Items button opens the items as cards; Open is one click. Off: the stock Items tab.

itemsClassic.name: Items: Classic Mode
itemsClassic.hint: On this client, the Items button opens Foundry's own Items tab.

showKeeps.name: Journal: Show keeps it visible
showKeeps.hint: When the GM shows a page, it is also made visible to the players it was shown to, so they can open it again from their journal case. Off: Show only flashes it. The Show options choose either way each time.

assetFolders.name: Journal: asset folders
assetFolders.hint: Where Not in a journal looks for pictures no journal page uses yet: folders relative to Data, one per line or separated by commas. Blank: the world's assets/handouts, assets/journal, assets/maps and assets/portraits.

handoutsJournal.name: Journal: Handouts journal
handoutsJournal.hint: The journal Add to the Handouts journal puts a picture in, made on first use (GM only).

sidebarTabs.name: Players see only the sidebar tabs they use
sidebarTabs.hint: Players lose the Combat, Placeables, Items, Rollable Tables, Cards and Macros tabs: no button, open or collapsed, and no way to switch or pop one out. Chat, Actors, Journal, Playlists, Compendium Packs, Settings and any tab a module adds stay. A GM's tabs are the rule below's. Turning it off brings the tabs back when each client reloads.

gmSidebarTabs.name: GMs see only the sidebar tabs they use
gmSidebarTabs.hint: GMs lose the Combat, Rollable Tables, Cards and Macros tabs: no button, and no way to switch or pop one out. Chat, Scenes, Placeables, Actors, Items, Journal, Playlists, Compendium Packs, Settings and any tab a module adds stay. Players' tabs are the rule above's. Turning it off brings the tabs back when each client reloads.
